description: This file defines the 'InboundEmailViewDetail' class extending 'ViewDetail', which manages the display logic for the inbound email detail view in the SuiteCRM application. It sets user permissions and context data for the view.

classes.name: InboundEmailViewDetail
classes.description: Class responsible for displaying the inbound email detail view. It extends the ViewDetail class and overrides the display method to assign user permission data to the view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides parent method to assign admin status and current user ID to the view before rendering.
